kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem delete-normalization-schema --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --normalization-schema-type log --normalization-schema-id PROCESS_QUERY_DNS_ACTIVITY --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteNormalizationSchema

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID

parameters.help_en:
